newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Talks to end Colombian truckers's strike collapse.
newsitem.headline: Talks to end Colombian truckers's strike collapse.

text.p: Talks aimed at ending a strike by Colombia's main truck drivers' union collapsed late on Tuesday with no agreement over key demands that the government set a minimum rate for highway freight, union officials said.
"The two sides have adopted very difficult, very radical positions," Javier Suarez, head of the Colombian Truck Drivers' Association (ACC), told Reuters.

Suarez said that the government had asked for 15 days to estabish minimum rates for overland freight. But he said this was unacceptable because governent officials, led by Transportation Minister Carlos Hernan Lopez, had already agreed to set minimum cargo rates as part of an accord ending a crippling, 11-day strike by the ACC last October.
